name: Cherry Punch Pre-Roll | 1g
description:
Grown With Premium Flower - We only use the highest quality indoor flower grown by some of the best cultivators in Michigan.

Exciting New Flavors - Exceptional flavor stemming from the most aromatic & appealing terpenes around.

The Highest Quality - Hand packed in our state of the art packaging facility to ensure a clean & even smoke in every pre-roll.

Made With Liquid Diamonds - All Hy-R pre-rolls are infused with the highest quality melted THCA. This guarantees a smooth burn with a serious punch.
